Hi Joshua, your Magic M. 40T hasn't shipped yet. It ships November 30, and your Miner D. and Power K. are already set aside at our Tennessee warehouse and will go out in the same box.

The production run of 300 units is on its way to our warehouses now. You can follow that shipment at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

When your miner ships, the tracking number will be emailed to (email hidden) It's worth checking your spam folder for it.
what happened to the 15th why wasnt an announment made

You're right to ask, Joshua, and I'm sorry. We gave you dates we didn't keep, and that's on us. During the first production run, a control board issue stopped production. It's fixed, and the final version has been approved. All 300 units are being built and shipped together, and your order ships November 30.

We emailed you about this on November 3 and sent factory photos on November 8. Some customers are finding our emails in junk, so please check there. Adding (email hidden) and (email hidden) to your contacts will help future updates reach your inbox.
my order delivery has been pushed back somewhere around 2 months and no ordering erly carrys no weight kinda disapppointed and a little worried

I hear you, Joshua. You ordered on August 1 and you've waited far longer than we told you. Being disappointed about that is fair.

Ordering early did count for something. You kept the $649 price on a unit that now sells for $799. For the delay, we've also given you a $50 refund in August and $50 in store credit in September.

As for the worry, the units are built and the final version has been approved. Your miner, Duster and Power K. ship together November 30, and the tracking number will be emailed to you as soon as it ships.
